name: app-leaf-house-app-icon-with-notification-badge
title: Leaf-House App Icon with Badge
whatItIs: Two dark panels: a phone corner with the icon beside Settings and Messages, and a huge version of the icon, an olive-gradient rounded square with a white house-and-leaf line mark and a red '1' badge.
whatItMeans: A single line mark on a moody olive glow feels natural and calm, and the red badge shows it alive in a real context.
techniques: Simple outlined mark merging two ideas (house and leaf)
Olive gradient fading to near-black in the icon tile
Close-up device crop beside familiar system icons
Red notification badge as a realism cue
Soft radial glow behind the enlarged icon

vocabulary.definition: A small red circle with a count on an icon.
A logo drawn with a single stroke weight.
Light spreading from a center point into darkness.
